summary: PR 662 at 6eaf6c114f3dd23ad901e47d2cf8e2532ade22a6 is test-only hardening and documentation, not a fix for the original issue. Its new regression explicitly accepts the original [A,B,C] then n-1 [A,B] zero-hit behavior. Independent base and candidate probes reproduced that zero hit on an AMD Instinct MI350X. The existing implementation can reuse a prefix only through a node that owns a recurrent state at exactly that depth: an explicit depth-2 checkpoint returns two indices, a real depth-64 checkpoint returns 64, and divergence before the first checkpoint returns zero.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual GPU-resident MambaRadixCache indices: short n-1=0, full owned leaf=3, explicit exact depth-2 checkpoint=2, long n-1 through a depth-64 checkpoint=64, divergence after checkpoint=64, divergence before checkpoint=0.
20 tests passed. The candidate's new exact short-prefix test passes by asserting a zero-token hit, so this is regression documentation rather than a passing-after fix for the source issue.
The independent assigned-GPU probe produced the same values as base, including the unresolved exact short n-1 zero hit and correct independent torch.arange references for supported owned checkpoints.
The delivered review report has no whitespace errors.

gpu_evidence: torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 reported CUDA/HIP execution available on AMD Instinct MI350X; cache values and independent torch.arange references were allocated on device cuda.
remaining_counterexamples: Insert [A,B,C] with its only recurrent state owned at depth 3, then match the fresh-prefill n-1 key [A,B]: device_indices remains length 0 at the exact candidate commit.
Divergence before the first real recurrent checkpoint returns zero reusable indices, even when attention KV structurally matches.
The candidate supplies no arbitrary-depth recurrent plus convolution checkpoint and no execution path that replays recurrent layers while retaining attention KV.
remaining_limitations: No hybrid-Mamba model weights were prepared, so end-to-end logits and latency were not measured. The source issue's exact short-prefix reuse remains unsupported by the current architecture unless an exact penultimate state is captured or a split-replay path is added. PR 662 changes only tests and reports; it changes no Python runtime implementation or native source, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
